english.title: Export / ship as stores / bring into the United Kingdom restricted / prohibited goods
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[exporter]_
(B)_[intending exporter]_
(C)_[agent of an exporter or intending exporter]_

of goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), which were

(D)_[exported]_
(E)_[shipped as stores]_
(F)_[brought to a place in the United Kingdom for the purpose of being exported]_
(G)_[brought to a place in the United Kingdom for the purpose of being shipped as stores]_

(H)_[exportation]_
(I)_[shipment]_

(J)_[was]_
(K)_[would have been]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 68(1) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale or three times the value of the goods involved, whichever is the greater.

Time limit for prosecutions
3 years
